category_title: Impulsive male students prone to rule-breaking and interruptions
minimal_context: The student is sitting in a circle participating in a philosophical discussion about whether there is life after death.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Welcome to our discussion circle. Today's question is: Is there life after death?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: No way. When you're dead, you're just dead.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Someone else just shared that they believe in an afterlife. What do you think about that?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: That's just a story people make up! It doesn't make any sense at all.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's wait and hear what the person next to you is saying.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Interrupting loudly without waiting to be called) But they are wrong! You can't prove it! I'm telling you, there's nothing after you die!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Welcome to our discussion circle. Today's question is: Is there life after death?

STUDENT: No way. When you're dead, you're just dead.

TUTOR: Someone else just shared that they believe in an afterlife. What do you think about that?

STUDENT: That's just a story people make up! It doesn't make any sense at all.

TUTOR: Let's wait and hear what the person next to you is saying.

STUDENT: (Interrupting loudly without waiting to be called) But they are wrong! You can't prove it! I'm telling you, there's nothing after you die!

task.content: Participating in a Community of Philosophical Inquiry (CoPI) session and engaging in structured argumentative dialogue discussing questions like 'Is there life after death?'
task.learning_goal: Agree/disagree with at least one previous speaker and give reasons for their agreement/disagreement

context.social_setting: Participants sit in a circle in order to see one another, with the facilitator outside the circle

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When children were excited and animated by the discussion and arguments
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Made a contribution without waiting to be called by the facilitator

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Interruptions on-task related to the dialogue
